key.name: shortcut-cursor
key.summary: Open the compact panel at the mouse pointer

key.name: shortcut-toggle
key.summary: Open the panel under the top bar icon (off by default; clicking the icon does this)

key.name: history-size
key.summary: How many unpinned items to keep

key.name: move-to-top-on-paste
key.summary: Move an item to the top of the history after pasting it

key.name: max-image-size-mb
key.summary: Images larger than this are not saved

key.name: ignore-password-managers
key.summary: Never record content marked as secret or copied from an ignored app

key.name: ignored-apps
key.summary: Apps whose copies are treated as sensitive (matched against window class, app id and name)

key.name: sensitive-timeout
key.summary: Seconds before a sensitive item is removed from history

key.name: clear-on-logout
key.summary: Clear unpinned history when a new session starts

key.name: private-until
key.summary: Unix time (seconds) when private mode ends, 0 for never

key.name: show-preview
key.summary: Show the preview pane in the top bar panel

key.name: fetch-link-titles
key.summary: Fetch the page title of copied links

key.name: clear-history-request
key.summary: Bumped by the preferences window to ask the shell to clear history

key.name: message-tray-accels-backup
key.summary: Shortcuts removed from GNOME's notification list toggle to avoid a conflict, restored on disable
